text:
mina: FYI shogi-v1 (q4a) bring-up on the mixed-locale suite shows bracket and quote reordering when Kanji and Hebrew are mixed inline. small repro + numbers below.

tereza: can you paste the minimal input + both detok outputs and model/tokenizer config?

mina: model: shogi-v1 q4a-pack, tokenizer=hybrid-kanji-2028. repro: Kanji + Hebrew inline.
```
input:  visible: 
# actual: 
# shown: 
# human line: 

# readable: 我在【新刊】裡看到: "מה זה המוצר הזה?"
expected detok (fp16): 我在【新刊】裡看到: "מה זה המוצר הזה?"
q4a detok: 我在】新刊【裡看到: "מה זה המוצר הזה?"
# note: corner brackets reversed and bracket pair moved across the Kanji span
```

hao: odd. likely bidi/detok ordering bug. does the packer introduce alias ids for corner brackets?

mina: token id diff for sample (fp16 vs q4a-pack):
```
# fp16 ids: [120,4567,888,9012,...]
# q4a ids : [120,4567,14221,9012,...]  # 14221 = pack-alias for LEFT_CORNER_BRACKET
```

hao: alias 14221 lacks mirror-neutral tag and the bidi resolver treats it as mirrored next to RTL span, flipping order. looks like alias->bidi interaction.

sam: metrics: zh(kanji)->he BLEU fp16 17.8, shogi-v1 fp16 17.6, shogi-v1 q4a 14.9 (drop ~2.7). zh->en unaffected. run: https://redwood-internal/eval/2845-shogi-q4a-mix

tereza: experiments to run: (A) reencode without aliases on 1k mixed samples, (B) mark pack-alias tokens mirror-neutral in bidi resolution, (C) quick detok post-normalize heuristic. which do you want first?

mina: start A and B in parallel, post results. i'll add the failing examples to ML issue ML-5201. triage:bisect assigned to @hao @sam.

triage-bot: started job triage/bisect/2845019999  runner-4  ETA ~20m. https://redwood-internal/ci/triage/2845019999

hao: quick local run A (pack disabled) on 1k mixes -> BLEU recovered to 17.7 and bracket order fixed on repro set. B (neutralize alias metadata) gives partial recovery (16.9).

sam: short-term mitigation: tokenizer post-normalize to replace alias punctuation with canonical codepoints near mixed-orientation spans. long-term: update packer to tag alias tokens mirror=neutral. open PR: https://redwood-internal/pull/ML-5204

mina: thanks. please add unit tests for Kanji+Hebrew bracket/quote combos and add streaming vs batch detok checks; streaming sometimes applies incremental mirroring and can differ.

triage-bot: job complete  summary: pack alias introduced mirror semantics -> detok flip. recommended remediation: tokenizer post-normalize + packer metadata fix.

tereza: will follow up with schedule on ML-5204 and run full multilingual smoke after PR lands. :thumbsup:
